section1.title: 1. Purpose of Collection and Use
section1.content: Smart JSA Bridge collects minimal personal information, which is used solely for service provision, improvement, and customer consultation.

item1.desc: Email address, service usage records, access logs, cookies, access IP information

item2.desc: User preference language and regional information

item3.desc: Automatically generated and collected during the website service usage process

section3.title: 3. Retention and Usage Period
section3.subtitle: In principle, the company destroys the information without delay after the purpose of collection and use is achieved.

step1.desc: Destroyed after storage for up to 3 months

step2.desc: Stored for 1 year after consultation ends

step3.desc: Stored for the period required by relevant laws and regulations

step4.desc: Information in electronic file format is deleted using technical methods that cannot reproduce the record

section4.title: 4. Third-Party Provision and Entrustment
section4.content: This service includes Google AdSense, and we inform you that third parties such as Google may install or read cookies on your browser to provide customized advertisements.

imageCaption: Smart JSA Bridge prioritizes the safety of your data.
